scene.surface: Cream-colored linen-textured jewelry display surface or neutral bust appropriate to the product type
scene.background: Flat, muted sage green matte background with soft gradient
scene.arrangement: Single hero product centered with balanced negative space; for sets, arranged as a cohesive group with clear hierarchy

camera.lens_behavior: Shallow depth of field with soft fall-off; creamy background bokeh; sharp focus on the center-front metallic texture and gemstones
camera.shooting_angle: Eye-level, straight-on or slight three-quarter perspective suited to the product type

lighting.setup: Large diffused softbox positioned at 45-degrees from camera-right; white bounce card at camera-left for soft fill; overhead silk for general diffusion
lighting.quality: Soft, wrap-around light with gentle shadow transitions; clean, bright highlights to define metallic edges and surface sheen

style: Minimalist editorial catalog, high-end lifestyle studio photography
quality_directives: Extreme detail on fabric weave and metal grain, no visible digital noise, professional color grading, realistic micro-reflections on metal surfaces, clean minimalist composition, consistent brand palette across all product types
negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3D render, CGI, plastic look, oversaturated, blurry product, watermark, text overlay, harsh shadows, cluttered background, lens flare, dust on lens, hands, model, packaging, price tag, paper tag, product tag, hang tag, label, sticker, barcode
